tools.name: register_platform
tools.description: Register a platform (tier cap: Watch 10, Fleet 50) with its initial changelog snapshot and operator-supplied price table

tools.name: ingest_changelog
tools.description: Ingest a changelog snapshot (hash-checked; expected_hash optional)

tools.name: probe
tools.description: Session-start probe: reconcile the effective default against changelog state -> verdict + signed attestation

tools.name: set_pin
tools.description: Set or clear (null) the pin for a platform

tools.name: verify_attestation
tools.description: Verify a signed effective-default attestation (forged/tampered attestations return valid: false)

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: Operator alert surface: STAGED/UNANNOUNCED/PIN_VIOLATED events for the caller's platforms

tools.name: delta_run
tools.description: Golden-task delta run, x402 pay-per-call $0.01/run: send the X-PAYMENT header on the /mcp request; without a verified payment the call answers HTTP 402 with the x402 challenge. Arguments are exactly the POST /delta-run body (see /docs).
